test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: International Women's Day is celebrated on?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8th march**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• International Women's Day is celebrated on 8th March.
 
• International Women's Day is a global day celebrating the social, economic, cultural, and political achievements of women.
 
• The day also marks a call to action for accelerating gender parity.
 
• This year's theme for International Day is "Women in leadership: Achieving an equal future in a COVID-19 world".​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• National Women's Day- 13 February
 
• National Girl Child Day- 24 January
 
• International Day of the Girl Child- 11 October​
